title: Finite type kernels into coherent restrictions on an open slice
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and $U\subseteq X$ an open. Let $\mathcal G$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and $\mathcal F$ a finite type $\mathcal O_U$-module [pqf-def-coherent], where $\mathcal O_U=\mathcal O_X|_U$ and sheaves of modules are as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For any morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G|_U$, its kernel is of finite type on $U$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian), part (2), applied on the open ringed space; Definition 01BV (definition-coherent)

proof.text: Extract finite local generating data q for F from hF. For every i, the finite-type property of q.generators i supplies a finite index type. Compose its generating epimorphism with phi restricted to q.X i. Apply the iterated-slice coherent relation lemma to this finite free map into G restricted twice, obtaining a finite type kernel for each composite.

Apply the local-generator kernel criterion to phi and q using these finite type composite kernels. It descends their quotient generators to the kernel of phi on U, proving the desired finite type condition.

proof_origin.place: Modules, Definition 01BV (2) and Lemma 01BY (2), local finite free relations and their image; formalized as the two explicit slice lemmas, combined by V4.
